question: How many trades were there in May 2014?
expected_sql: SELECT COUNT(fact_trades.TradeID) AS trade_count FROM atlas.dwd.fact_trades AS fact_trades INNER JOIN atlas.dwd.dim_date AS dim_date ON fact_trades.SK_CreateDateID = dim_date.SK_DateID WHERE dim_date.CalendarMonthID = 20145 LIMIT 100

fibo_concepts.note: Trade count = number of securities transaction events
